tools.name: checkfront_get_company
tools.description: Fetch the connected Checkfront account's company configuration — name, URL, plan, currency, timezone, locale and date/time formats. A cheap way to confirm the host and credentials work. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/company.

tools.name: checkfront_list_categories
tools.description: List the inventory categories (e.g. Tours, Rentals, Accommodations) with their ids, names, display order and item counts. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/category.

tools.name: checkfront_list_items
tools.description: List the enabled inventory items (tours, activities, rentals, rooms). With NO dates this is the plain catalogue. Pass start_date (and end_date / param quantities) to get a RATED response: per-item availability, pricing and a SLIP token — the SLIP is what checkfront_add_to_booking_session needs to bo

tools.name: checkfront_get_item
tools.description: Fetch one inventory item's details. Pass start_date / end_date and param quantities (e.g. {"adults": 2}) for a RATED response with availability (rate.status, rate.available), the price breakdown and the SLIP used to book it. For parent/child grouped items, rate the CHILD item. Checkfront: GET /api/3

tools.name: checkfront_get_availability_calendar
tools.description: Day-by-day available inventory over a date range — for one item (item_ids with a single id), several items, or a whole category. Use it to answer 'which days next month still have space?'. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/item/{item_id}/cal or GET /api/3.0/item/cal.

tools.name: checkfront_list_bookings
tools.description: List bookings, newest filters first — by status, customer, dates, item or partner. Each row has the booking code, status, totals (total, tax_total, paid_total), customer name/email, summary and date_desc. Paged (default 100/page); the response's request.pages tells you how many pages exist. Checkfro

tools.name: checkfront_get_booking
tools.description: Fetch extended information on one booking — status, dates, customer, form fields, line items and totals. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/booking/{booking_id}.

tools.name: checkfront_list_booking_notes
tools.description: List the notes left on bookings across the account (default: the past 30 days), each with its booking code, author account id (0 = customer), date, body and whether it is private. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/booking/notes.

tools.name: checkfront_get_booking_form
tools.description: Fetch the customer-details form for a booking (booking_form_ui): every field id (customer_name, customer_email, …), its label, type and whether it is required. Call this before checkfront_create_booking to know which `form` fields to send. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/booking/form.

tools.name: checkfront_get_booking_session
tools.description: Read a booking session — the in-progress 'cart' — with its line items (keyed by line_id), dates, sub_total, tax, total and amount due. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/booking/session.

tools.name: checkfront_search_customers
tools.description: Look up customers by exact email, full name or phone number (exact matches; non-unique fields such as name can return several). Results are in the `customers` object. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/customer.

tools.name: checkfront_get_customer
tools.description: Fetch one customer's contact details and their bookings (codes with created dates). Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/customer/{customer_id}.

tools.name: checkfront_list_events
tools.description: List the date-based events that change price or availability — seasonal rates (SE), specials (SP), discounts (DC), closures (status U) — with their dates, recurrence, pricing rule and the items/categories they apply to. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/event.

tools.name: checkfront_list_staff_accounts
tools.description: List the staff (and partner) accounts on the Checkfront account — ids, names, emails, login ids and whether enabled. The account_id is what CHECKFRONT_ON_BEHALF takes. Checkfront: GET /api/3.0/account.

tools.name: checkfront_add_to_booking_session
tools.description: Start or modify a booking session: add one or more SLIPs (from a rated checkfront_get_item / checkfront_list_items call), replace a line with a new SLIP (line_id + slip), or alter lines (quantity, 'remove', 'optin'/'optout' for package add-ons). Holds the inventory while the session is open; NOTHING

tools.name: checkfront_end_booking_session
tools.description: Abandon a booking session: 'clear' empties its items, 'end' closes it. Releases the inventory it was holding; no booking is affected. Checkfront: POST /api/3.0/booking/session/clear or /booking/session/end.

tools.name: checkfront_create_booking
tools.description: Commit a booking: from a session_id (built with checkfront_add_to_booking_session) or directly from SLIPs, plus the customer form fields (see checkfront_get_booking_form for which are required — typically customer_name and customer_email). Creates a real reservation that consumes inventory and may n

tools.name: checkfront_update_booking_status
tools.description: Set a booking's status — e.g. confirm a pending booking (PAID/PART), put it on HOLD or WAIT(list), or cancel it (VOID/STOP). Reversible: set it back to the previous status the same way. Does NOT record a payment. Optionally triggers the account's customer notifications. Checkfront: POST /api/3.0/boo

tools.name: checkfront_add_booking_note
tools.description: Add a note to a booking, logged under the staff account the API acts on behalf of. Checkfront: POST /api/3.0/booking/{booking_id}/note.

tools.name: checkfront_check_in_booking
tools.description: Mark a guest as arrived (check in) or departed (check out). Checkfront adds a note under the acting account. VOID and cancelled bookings cannot be checked in or out. Checkfront: POST /api/3.0/booking/{booking_id}/checkin or /checkout.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "checkfront_get_company" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: checkfront_get_company, checkfront_list_bookings, checkfront_search_customers, checkfront_list_staff_accounts, checkfront_add_to_booking_session, checkfront_update_booking_status, checkfront_check_in_booking · Private data: checkfront_get_company, checkfront_list_items, checkfront_list_booking_notes, checkfront_get_customer, checkfront_update_booking_status · Public sink: checkfront_list_bookings, checkfront_get_booking_form, checkfront_search_customers, checkfront_add_to_booking_session, checkfront_end_booking_session, checkfront_create_booking, checkfront_update_booking_status, checkfront_add_booking_note, checkfront_check_in_booking · Destructive: checkfront_add_to_booking_session.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: checkfront_get_company, checkfront_list_bookings, checkfront_search_customers, checkfront_list_staff_accounts, checkfront_add_to_booking_session, checkfront_update_booking_status, checkfront_check_in_booking · Private data: checkfront_get_company, checkfront_list_items, checkfront_list_booking_notes, checkfront_get_customer, checkfront_update_booking_status · Public sink: checkfront_list_bookings, checkfront_get_booking_form, checkfront_search_customers, checkfront_add_to_booking_session, checkfront_end_booking_session, checkfront_create_booking, checkfront_update_booking_status, checkfront_add_booking_note, checkfront_check_in_booking · Destructive: checkfront_add_to_booking_session

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
